[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 240
- Description: Sophia Vault Credential Migration — UAT (U1–U7), krake_nginx pin fix, docs + tracker
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/476
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1198
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1217
  
  Details:
  Completed the vault credential migration plan through UAT on the deployed service (1254da2), plus the two follow-on fixes surfaced by the UAT.
  
  **Units delivered this thread**
  - **UAT U1–U7 (the completion gate)** — run live against deployed 1254da2: vault initialized (True, 42 creds); SSH keys resolve VAULT-FIRST and fingerprint-match the on-box PEMs; reachable-fleet sweep rc=0 (autopilot, dao_protocol, krake_data, seni_redis, seni_ror, seni_sk, seni_sql). In-scope (the 3 SSH keys): ALL PASS. Corrected U2 name (`github_krake_pat` → vault `krake_io_pat`); U6/U7 out-of-scope (not in vault, filed).
  - **Unit 6 (partial)** — archived the 3 unreferenced top-level `/home/ubuntu/*.pem` dups → `/home/ubuntu/.migrated_to_vault/` (guarded pre-flight: 0 live refs; SSH re-verified after). `~/.ssh/*.pem` HELD pending Gary (breaks ~21 `~/.ssh/config` aliases + drops the fallback safety net).
  - **krake_nginx pin gap** — pre-existing defect found in UAT (trusts the box ed25519 key, not server_us as the comment claimed); fixed with a host-local pin + regression tests; live rc=255 → rc=0.
  - **Docs (Unit 5) + tracker** — §7.2 + CREDENTIAL_HANDOFF_PROTOCOL vault-native; plan RESUME HERE + UAT results recorded; 3 parked creds filed in OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.
  
  **Evidence PRs:** #471 (ssh_run vault-native + host-aware, prior), #472 (df-alert → fleet_probe.py, prior), #476 (krake_nginx pin), #1198 (docs), #1217 (UAT results). All merged.
  
  **Also diagnosed:** the (d) PR-creation 401/403 was a GitHub REST rate-limit (5000/hr), not a credential fault — resolved on retry after the window reset.
  
  Remaining open item is governor-owned: the (b) `~/.ssh/*.pem` archive decision (flagged to Gary).
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 400.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
